intent.user_prompt: Build an 8-bit dual-stream join datapath as a complete SR2FPGA Verilog RTL project. This is component topology t4_dual_stream_join, difficulty tier T4. Use two skid_buffer instances feeding stream_join, then accumulator_core, then stream_stage. The design must implement this black-box behavior: two valid-ready input streams are buffered, synchronized, joined, accumulated, and staged. Keep rtl/top.v as the integration wrapper and keep each reusable component in a separate RTL file. Preserve these interface contracts: top.in0_valid -> skid_buffer.in_valid; top.in0_data -> skid_buffer.in_data; top.in1_valid -> skid_buffer.in_valid; top.in1_data -> skid_buffer.in_data; skid_buffer.out_valid -> stream_join.in0_valid; skid_buffer.out_data -> stream_join.in0_data; skid_buffer.out_valid -> stream_join.in1_valid; skid_buffer.out_data -> stream_join.in1_data; stream_join.in0_ready -> skid_buffer.out_ready; stream_join.in1_ready -> skid_buffer.out_ready; stream_join.out_valid -> accumulator_core.sample_valid; stream_join.out_data -> accumulator_core.sample; accumulator_core.sample_ready -> stream_join.out_ready; accumulator_core.sample_valid -> stream_stage.in_valid; accumulator_core.sum -> stream_stage.in_data; stream_stage.in_ready -> accumulator_core.sample_ready; stream_stage.out_valid -> top.out_valid; stream_stage.out_data -> top.out_data. Include system_his.json, manifest.json, timing constraints, predicted QoR, and a bounded self-checking testbench that prints TEST_PASS only on success or TEST_FAIL on failure.
intent.design_goal: Implement a pipelined dual-stream join with buffering, synchronization, accumulation, and output staging for 8-bit data streams.
assumptions: Top-level ready outputs for input streams are provided but the contract mapping omitted them; they are present as in0_ready and in1_ready.
Output sink has no backpressure (always ready).

components.name: skid_buffer
components.intent: Skid buffer for pipelining and flow-control decoupling.

components.name: stream_join
components.intent: Synchronizes two input streams, producing a combined output stream.

components.name: accumulator_core
components.intent: Accumulates input samples into a running sum.

components.name: stream_stage
